## Problem Statement

Describe the workflow friction or missing capability you want to solve.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working (desktop CV engine, Mini-HUD, Browser Extension, route planner, or exporter).

## Anti-Cheat & Passive-CV Compatibility Check

Genshin-Helper strictly remains **100% passive Computer Vision** (screen pixels + public map data only):
- [ ] This feature does **not** require reading/writing game memory or injecting DLLs.
- [ ] This feature does **not** require sending synthetic keyboard/mouse input (`SendInput`) into the game window.

## Alternatives Considered

Any workarounds or alternative designs you considered.
